description: Rakuten Ichiba / Rakuten Affiliate Japan catalog adapter. Uses the documented v2026-07-01 Rakuten Web Service Search and Genre APIs. Requires a caller registered applicationId plus accessKey; the optional affiliateId is supplied by the caller. Distinct from Rakuten Advertising global publisher APIs.

capabilities.title: Use a matching Rakuten Web Service applicationId and accessKey in process memory
capabilities.note: Current endpoints require both values. applicationId is a required query parameter; accessKey is transmitted only through its documented HTTP header. Live authenticated replay awaits caller-owned credentials.

capabilities.title: Search by keyword, shopCode, itemCode, or genreId with exact current API request fields
capabilities.note: GET /ichibams/api/IchibaItem/Search/20260701 uses format=json and formatVersion=2. Search request shape has local fixture coverage only.

capabilities.title: Collect listing-level itemPrice as a decimal JPY amount and preserve price-basis ranges bound to itemCode and shopCode
capabilities.note: The API documents itemPrice plus itemPriceBaseField and separate all-item (Min/Max1), searchable-item (Min/Max2), and purchasable-item (Min/Max3) bounds. The normalized itemPrice is explicitly listing-level and is not claimed to be a selected SKU/variant price.

capabilities.title: Retrieve one exact listing by its documented shopCode:item identifier
capabilities.note: The documentation supplies itemCode as an Item Search selector; this adapter reuses that endpoint, requests one hit, then binds exact itemCode and shopCode. It does not invent a separate detail route.

capabilities.title: Filter product results by Rakuten Ichiba genreId and read genre hierarchy
capabilities.note: Item search accepts genreId; getGenre uses documented GET /ichibagt/api/IchibaGenre/Search/20260701.

capabilities.title: Read documented 1-based page results within hits 1-30 and pages 1-100
capabilities.note: The adapter reports API pageCount and nextPage only when another documented page exists.

capabilities.title: Request affiliateUrl only when a caller explicitly supplies its own Rakuten Affiliate ID
capabilities.note: Affiliate ID is never inferred, looked up, or stored. Rakuten docs state itemUrl can equal affiliateUrl when affiliateId is supplied; the adapter preserves affiliateUrl separately and only reports a canonical URL when a static direct or pc/m target verifies the Rakuten host, shopCode path, and an exact path segment matching the API itemCode suffix. It never follows a tracking URL or synthesizes an item URL.

capabilities.title: Resolve a canonical merchant URL only from a verified API itemUrl or static affiliate pc/m target
capabilities.note: Targets lacking a literal itemCode path-segment match return canonicalUrl:null and targetVerified:false; itemCode/shopCode and the affiliateUrl are still preserved. The client does not infer URL slug transformations or assume leaf equality.

capabilities.title: Preserve item-specific affiliateRate percentages when returned by the official API
capabilities.note: The current item-search docs expose affiliateRate. It is returned as observed item-specific metadata and is never replaced with a fixed 2-4% assumption.

capabilities.title: Interactive Rakuten login and application registration flow
capabilities.applicabilityReason: This adapter accepts already registered app credentials supplied by its caller; it does not sign in, register an app, or request affiliate enrollment.

capabilities.title: Rakuten Advertising global publisher network catalog or program enrollment
capabilities.applicabilityReason: This service entry is specifically Rakuten Ichiba and Rakuten Affiliate for Japan; Rakuten Advertising global publisher APIs are a distinct integration.

capabilities.title: Change a Rakuten cart, place an order, or alter account/profile settings
capabilities.applicabilityReason: The requested Rakuten Ichiba work is limited to catalog, price, category, and optional affiliate URL reads.
